title: Chaotic billiards in a superellipse
plain: The billiard table x⁴+y⁴ ≤ 1 is smooth and convex but has four flat points, so it has no caustics. Show a positive fraction of its phase space is chaotic.
math: Let $\Phi$ be the billiard map of $\{x^4+y^4\le1\}$ with its invariant Liouville measure $\nu$. Prove that the metric entropy $h_\nu(\Phi)$ is positive.
